searchText: Is there any interest in a formal or informal precompile registry, outside of the mainnet hardfork set? Enterprise Ethereum Alliance has had non-standard precompile adresses for years now, but we are starting to see L2 solutions that use a precompile for what amount to system calls. Also, chains like Celo have already activated the BLS-12 precompiles on their chain. This may be a critical mass to make it matter. Something along the line of the rfc1340 well known port numbers and/or chainid.network +1 for such a registry. We can also have a genesis file field for precompiles or to reserve ranges explicitly for enterprise deployments.
